mentions.name: Airtable x Yahoo Pipes mashup
mentions.description: This tool is conceived as a mashup of Airtable and Yahoo Pipes (neither of which the builder has used) that enhances information in order to visualize it.
mentions.problem: In each job, the builder finds themselves needing to enhance information in order to visualize it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
i guess some kind of a mashup Airtable x Yahoo Pipes, but i've never used either of these

in each job i find myself trying to enhance information in order to visualize it, so this time i'm finally giving it a try
